title: fix(plugin-form,fields,i18n): the line-items panel, the grid field and the master-detail heading finish speaking the user's language (objectui#11145)
body:
Fixes #11145
Clause-②: no

## What

Under a zh session the rest of the line-items chrome still rendered English beside a Chinese page. Three sites were measured on the card: the record page's `record:line_items` panel with no parent record (`Save the record first to add line items.`), the grid footer of a panel with a `totalField` (`Total`), and a `MasterDetailForm` collection with no `title` (heading `Line Items`). They and the rest of the family's chrome now read the locale packs.

Only the defaults move. An authored collection `title` still wins, and so does a failure message the server sent. Apart from two tooltips (see "One meaning, one key"), English output is byte-identical to the literals it replaces, with and without an i18n provider.

## Where each string goes

| Component | String | Key | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LineItemsPanel` | `Loading…` | `common.loading` | reused (the triage named it) |
| `LineItemsPanel` | `Save the record first to add line items.` | `form.lineItems.saveRecordFirst` | new |
| `LineItemsPanel` | `This record’s line items have not been loaded.` | `form.lineItems.notLoaded` | new |
| `LineItemsPanel` | `Failed to load line items` (fallback) | `form.lineItems.loadFailed` | new: `form.saveError` / `organization.*.loadFailed` say other things |
| `LineItemsPanel` | `Failed to save line items` (fallback) | `form.lineItems.saveFailed` | new |
| `LineItemsPanel` | no-`childObject` config hint | `form.lineItems.noChildObject` | new, with a `{{property}}` hole |
| `GridField` footer (read-only and editable) | `Total` | `form.masterDetail.total` | reused: the word the master-detail totals stack uses for the same figure (zh 合计); the footer is what shows when that stack does not |
| `GridField` chooser button | `Columns` | `table.columns` | reused (the table's column word; `@object-ui/fields` already reads `table.*` rows) |
| `GridField` chooser heading | `Optional columns` | `fields.grid.optionalColumns` | new |
| `GridField` computed cell tooltip | `Computed` | `fields.grid.computed` | new |
| `GridField` drag handle | `Drag to reorder` | `view.dragToReorder` | reused (the view manager's row drag handle, same meaning) |
| `GridField` row action | `Open row` | `fields.grid.openRow` | new |
| `GridField` row action | `Duplicate row` | `fields.grid.duplicateRow` | new |
| `GridField` row action | `Remove row` | `fields.grid.removeRow` | new |
| `MasterDetailForm` collection heading | `Line Items` | `form.lineItems.title` | reused through a new `useFormChromeTranslation` row, per the triage (not a new key) |

The ten new keys are in all ten packs. `check:i18n-drift` reports 0 `en` values changed.

## One meaning, one key

Each row action now has ONE key, read by both its `aria-label` and its `title`. The en text kept for each meaning is the accessible name it already had, which is also the choice that moves the fewest pins (measured with `git grep -n` over every test file for the six strings: `Open row` is queried in `GridField.test.tsx` and `MasterDetailForm.busReread-10853.test.tsx`, `Remove row` in four files; `Open full form`, `Duplicate line`, `Duplicate row` and `Drag to reorder` are queried by no test). **Moved pins: none.**

- open the row in the full form: `Open row` (the tooltip was `Open full form`);
- duplicate the row: `Duplicate row` (the tooltip was `Duplicate line`);
- remove the row: `Remove row` (it has no tooltip, and none is added);
- the drag handle: `Drag to reorder` (already one text).

The changeset states the same list.

## Which translation path, and why

- **Panel: its own `useLineItemsTranslation` table**, which objectui#11131 started. Six rows are added.
- **The failure fallbacks are resolved when the banner renders, not when the failure is caught.** `load` is a `useCallback` that an effect depends on, so calling `t` inside it would put `t` in that dependency list and re-run the load whenever `t` changes identity. Instead the panel's `error` state now holds either the server's message or which operation failed, and the banner picks the text. A server `e.message` still wins, and an empty one still falls through to the fallback, as the old `||` did.
- **The config hint keeps its code element.** The pack sentence carries a `{{property}}` hole. The panel asks for it with the hole filled by itself and splits on it, following `ConcurrentUpdateDialog`'s `detail.concurrentUpdateDescription`. So the property name `childObject` is never translated and still renders as code.
- **Grid: `useFieldTranslation` with an inline `defaultValue` at each call site**, as objectui#11131 did. `check:i18n-keys` holds each default to its `en` value.
- **`MasterDetailForm`: one `form.lineItems.title` row in `formChrome.ts`**, equal to the `en` pack's.

## Tests

New pins, 22 tests in 4 files:

- `packages/plugin-form/src/lineItemsChrome.i18n-11145.test.tsx` (zh). The three measured sites: no-parent panel 保存记录后才能添加明细行。, the `totalField` footer 合计, and the untitled master-detail heading 明细行. Also the loading line 加载中…, the load and save fallbacks 明细行加载失败 / 明细行保存失败, rows held for another parent 此记录的明细行尚未加载。, and the no-`childObject` hint in zh with `childObject` still inside the code element. CONTROLs: a server message shows as sent, and an authored collection `title` renders as written.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.i18nChrome-11145.test.tsx`. One pin per row-action meaning in zh (拖动排序 / 打开行 / 复制行 / 删除行), each asserting that the `aria-label` and the `title` agree. An en-provider control asserts the same for the English. Also the footer 合计 (editable and read-only), the computed cell 自动计算, and the chooser 列 / 可选列.
- Two `.no-provider` companions pin the English byte for byte with no provider mounted. That includes the hint's full text and the two unified tooltips.

Reverse verification, run with the fix committed at `4e9e04228`. The four source files (`LineItemsPanel.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `formChrome.ts`, `GridField.tsx`) were checked out from the base `3a0e7ab05`, keeping the packs and the pins, and a trap restored them. An on-disk grep confirmed the swap (`form.lineItems.saveRecordFirst` in the panel 1 → 0, the `Save the record first` literal back, `openRowLabel` in the grid 1 → 0, the `'Line Items'` literal back in the form). Over the four pin files the result was **13 failed / 9 passed (22)**, the predicted count and direction:
- red: every zh case except the two CONTROLs, the en-provider row-action case and the grid's no-provider case (both assert the unified tooltips);
- green: the two CONTROLs and the plugin-form no-provider file (its English did not change).

After the restore, `git diff HEAD` was empty and all four blob hashes matched HEAD.

Runs (declared narrowing: package-scoped, not the repo farm):
- At `d32cd3964`:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/masterDetailFormI18nLabelManifest.test.ts`: **76 files passed; 1244 passed, 13 skipped**. The de `„…“` census did not move, because no new de value quotes a span.
  - `packages/plugin-form/`: **151 files passed; 1763 passed, 1 skipped**.
  - `packages/fields/src/widgets/`: **105 files; 959 passed**.
  - The rest of `packages/fields/src` (`__tests__/` plus the 9 top-level test files): **119 passed, 1 skipped (120); 2559 passed, 7 skipped**.
- The last commit, `b7b0a5795`, only narrows `panelError`'s parameter from `any` to `unknown`. At that head:
  - `@object-ui/plugin-form` type-check exits 0;
  - `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel*`, `lineItemsChrome*`, `recordFormsErrorClears-10682.test.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm*`, `formChrome*` and `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField*`: **43 files, 411 passed**.
- `pnpm --filter` type-check for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-form`: all exit 0. They ran after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-form^...'` (11/11 tasks). Both packages' `tsconfig.test.json` list the new test files (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 18 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files at `b7b0a5795` exits 0, with 0 errors and 0 warnings on changed lines. The 66 warnings all sit on untouched lines. The 18-file count is read from `--format json`. `eslint.config.js` configures no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- At `b7b0a5795`, all exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals` and `check:self-import`. `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only and lists none of the new or reused keys.

## `check:changeset-claims`: two pending changesets name files this diff touches

Both paragraphs were read and both are still true:
- `.changeset/6625-retire-fieldmeta-decimals.md` names `GridField.tsx` for its `.scale` positive control. That file has 4 `.scale` reads at the base and 4 at the head, and this diff touches no `scale` / `decimals` line.
- `.changeset/6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers.md` names `en.ts` for the `console.nav` strings. This diff adds keys under `form.lineItems` and `fields.grid` only, and touches no `console` / `nav` line in any pack.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two English strings of the same family are left.** Both were measured by an uncommitted zh probe at `b7b0a5795` (2 of 2 held on the wrong answer):
  - `GridField`'s invalid-cell tooltip (the label, then ` is required`) reads `Qty is required` under zh. `validation.required` (`{{field}} is required`) already exists.
  - `MasterDetailForm`'s no-`childObject` hint (`This collection has no child object configured…`) is English under zh. So are its two sibling config hints, read in the source but not probed. They are outside this card's named sites and the claim's file surface, so they are reported to the seat and not touched here.
- `Remove row` still has no tooltip while the other three row actions do. Nothing was added, because that would be a behaviour change this card did not ask for.
- Out of scope per the triage: the list-mode empty text's hole (`detail.add`) vs the `Add line` button.
